1084-4279-7286.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-7286.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-7286.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1417-4279-6794--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1417-4279-6794--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4742-4770-6006-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4659-5003-6495-6644.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4659-5003-6495-6644.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

222-527-728-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1170-2099-4030-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-4030-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Starnheim Courser.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

4871-5220-5686-7855--180.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, Pitiless Plunderer, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat

855-2021-2060-6774.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1849-3132-3259.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1849-3132-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3132-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1090-3375-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

3249-5173-5334-6798.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

11-5195-6526-7506.description:
Cast Flamehold Grappler by paying {U}{R}{W}.
When Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Cast Replicate by paying its mana cost, targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Replicate, with the copy targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Replicate, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Replicate
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Replicate.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Replicate to your hand and creating a copy of Replicate targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Replicate copy, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast.
Activate up to four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Replicate.
Repeat from step 3.

240-4050-4875.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-4050-4875.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-5223.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-5223.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-5223.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

856-4321-5686-7396.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Food.
You control at least one additional creature.
856-4321-5686-7396.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food and Blood token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2457-2557-4289-6968.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3532-4030-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

618-2438-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1003-4659-5220-6900.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

339-677-4885-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Siren of the Silent Song

1557-3525-4289.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard a card and mill a card.
Repeat.

4222-6218-6723.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with an oil counter on it

565-1858-3120--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-3120--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2279-5058-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

856-2279-3967-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4826-5702-5954-6441.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
4826-5702-5954-6441.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
4826-5702-5954-6441.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to Archelos.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 3.

2043-4365-6252.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Boommobile that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
When the Boommobile tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2043-4365-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1887-3569-4050-4577.notablePrerequisites: Magnanimous Magistrate has at least three reprieve counters.
1887-3569-4050-4577.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Pollenbright Druid, adding one mana of any color.
Pollenbright Druid dies, triggering Magnanimous Magistrate, causing you to remove two reprieve counters from Magnanimous Magistrate and return Pollenbright Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Pollenbright Druid enters the battlefield, causing you to proliferate, putting two reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Repeat.

322-851-2657-2757.notablePrerequisites:
You have a basic land card in hand.
You control a basic Forest.
322-851-2657-2757.description:
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a basic land card, creating two 2/2 Bear creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Bear, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Activate Groundskeeper by paying {1}{G}, returning a basic land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1363-1636-4026.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand.
Elvish Piper and Tradewind Rider do not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You control at least one additional creature.
1363-1636-4026.description:
Activate a creature you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Elvish Piper by paying {G} and tapping it, putting any creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Riders by tapping it and two other creatures you control, returning a creature card from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1558-2047-4840.notablePrerequisites: Mechanized Production attached to Myr Battlesphere.
1558-2047-4840.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere.
The Myr Battlesphere token enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Myr Battlesphere token and sacrificing the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
